highlights.description: One directory per course: course.json, a section.json per section, HTML decks with narration, translations, pronunciations, quizzes with answer keys, and published state, all JSON with camelCase properties
Lessons discovered from decks: a slide with `data-lesson` starts a lesson and its `data-id` is the lesson's stable ID, in videoascode's deck conventions
`coursespec validate` reports every problem with its file, location, code, and fix, as text or JSON, for one course or every course beneath a directory
Content fingerprints of each lesson's slides and narration in every language, so `coursespec lessons` reports what changed since it was published, even in a fresh clone

added.description: Go types for the course and section manifests, lessons, quizzes, pronunciations, and published state
`deck` package: slides, lessons, narration with `[PAUSE:ms]` directives, the files a deck loads, transcript matching by slide ID or position, and content fingerprints

`coursespec.Load` resolves a course directory into one value with strict decoding, lessons discovered from decks, translations, quizzes, pronunciations, and published state; `coursespec.Find` lists every course beneath a directory; planned sections load without their files
Generated, embedded, and linted JSON Schemas for course.json, section.json, quiz.json, and published.json

`validate` package: schema, ID, section, deck, transcript, quiz, change-log, and published-state checks, with warnings for unnarrated slides, long lessons, remote deck files, missing translations, answer patterns, and unversioned changes; publish status for each lesson and quiz
`coursespec` command: `validate`, `lessons`, and `schema`, with text and JSON output
A platform `revision` in published state and `coursespec.WritePublished`

documentation.description: Requirements, design, plan, and roadmap for the format, including quiz-only and planned sections, self-contained decks, and fingerprints that ignore a slide's own ID
Documentation site with guides for the course directory, decks and narration, quizzes, published state, validation, AI agents, and the Go library, plus the findings and schema references

tests.description: Decks, loading, every validation rule against a test course, schema freshness, and the CLI
Published state with a platform revision

dependencies.description: golang.org/x/net v0.61.0, github.com/spf13/cobra v1.10.2, and github.com/invopop/jsonschema v0.14.0 for schema generation
